outputs.explanation: This is a diagram/bar representation of a single calculated percentage (illumination overhead) per exposure time setting, not an average computed across biological/technical replicates, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves, mean±s.e.m.). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement because overlaying raw points would make them unreadable.
Panel E shows representative micrographs (with a color-coded intensity overlay), not a quantitative summary plot.
Panel F shows the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m. but also plots the individual per-cell data points (color-coded by cell, n=5), satisfying the requirement.
Panel G shows the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m. but also plots the individual per-cell data points (color-coded by cell, n=5), satisfying the requirement.
Panel H shows the fitted mean curve with shaded s.e.m. but also plots the individual per-cell data points (color-coded by cell, n=5), satisfying the requirement.
Panel I is a time-series of representative micrographs, not a summary plot.
Panel J is a line plot showing average photobleaching curves with shaded s.e.m. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
